result.instructions: Tools for Simple Analytics, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Simple Analytics data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run simpleanalytics_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simpleanalytics_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simpleanalytics_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. simpleanalytics_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simpleanalytics_list_websites
tools.title: List websites
tools.description: List the websites of the Simple Analytics account (hostnames to use in the other tools). Good first call. Admin API: GET /api/websites.

tools.name: simpleanalytics_get_stats
tools.title: Get traffic summary
tools.description: Aggregated traffic for one website and date range: total pageviews, unique visitors and the median seconds on page. Optional filters narrow it to a page, country, referrer, UTM value, browser, OS, device or metadata value. Stats API: GET /<hostname>.json.

hostname.description: Website hostname as shown in Simple Analytics, e.g. example.com (from simpleanalytics_list_websites).

start.description: Start date: YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday or today-30d. Default: 1 month ago.

end.description: End date (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday or today-1d. Default: today.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam. Default: the website setting.

page.description: Only this page path, e.g. /pricing. A trailing * matches a prefix (/blog/*).

pages.description: Only these page paths, comma separated (/contact,/product/*).

metadata.description: Exact metadata filters as {key: value}; all must match.

tools.name: simpleanalytics_export_datapoints
tools.title: Export raw data points
tools.description: Raw, unsampled page views or events of one website for a date range, as rows with only the fields asked for. The reply is capped at max_rows (default 100, max 1000) rows and 2 MB; "truncated" says more exist, so narrow the range. Rows are cut to about 40 000 characters of JSON. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH for one hour (start and end the same day). Robots are left out unless asked. Needs the user id too. Export API: GET /api/export/datapoints.

hostname.description: Website hostname as shown in Simple Analytics, e.g. example.com (from simpleanalytics_list_websites).

fields.description: Fields to export (default added_iso, path, country_code, device_type, document_referrer). All: added_date, added_iso, added_unix, browser_name, browser_version, country_code, datapoint, device_type, document_referrer, duration_seconds, hostname, hostname_original, is_robot, is_unique, lang_language, lang_region, os_name, os_version, path, path_and_query, query, referrer_hostname, referrer_path, screen_height, screen_width, scrolled_percentage, session_id, user_agent, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_medium, utm_source, utm_term, uuid, viewport_height, viewport_width, metadata.<key>_<text|int|bool|date>. datapoint is for events only; duration_seconds, is_unique and scrolled_percentage for pageviews only.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam. Default: the website setting.
